flow-definition.description: HEADSLING iOS App Store 构建、签名、验证与上传。默认从本地 /Users/daisei/HeadGame 已保存源码快照构建，支持 Git 分支；源码必须使用独立存储桶 headsling-assets-664894817585。应用版本读取构建源码的 Unity Player Settings Version，构建编号沿用 Jenkins BUILD_NUMBER。管线源：/Users/daisei/HeadGame/Jenkinsfile.ios。

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: SOURCE_MODE
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Local snapshot includes saved, unpushed source changes; Git builds the selected branch.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: LOCAL_SOURCE_PATH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Read-only source for LOCAL_SNAPSHOT. Caches and credentials are excluded.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BRANCH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Git branch for GIT mode. The branch must use the dedicated HEADSLING asset bucket.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: CLEAN_LIBRARY
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Delete the Unity Library cache before building.

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: UPLOAD_APP_STORE
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Validate and upload the IPA to App Store Connect.
